scorecard.name: Confirmed the issue is resolved
scorecard.coaching: Agent failed to verify international call connectivity before ending call, stating customer must test later due to propagation delays.

grader.scenario: International call bar removal on elderly mother's landline; propagation delay prevents live confirmation
grader.notes: Good call where agent was highly professional, empathetic, and resolved call bar, failing only confirmed resolved due to Openreach exchange propagation delay.

items.name: Branding and Survey Check
items.evidence: Agent opened with 'Thank you for calling S-Net landline customer services' at [00:00] and closed with 'Thank you for choosing S-Net' in final lines.

items.name: Hold time and Dead Air
items.evidence: Hold was announced with could I place you on hold and thanked upon return without unmanaged dead air.

items.name: Verified customer
items.evidence: Verified full postal address and security PIN within the first 240 seconds.

items.name: Personalized the call/ticket appropriately
items.evidence: Agent addressed customer as Linnea throughout the call.

items.name: Empathy & Acknowledgment Statement
items.evidence: Agent demonstrated empathy at turn 22 ('I completely understand how alarming and frightening that was for your mother, Linnea...') and customer had no unhandled outbursts.

items.name: Paraphrasing
items.evidence: Agent paraphrased customer issue accurately at turn 2 ('If I understand correctly, your mother's landline is unable to connect international calls...').

items.name: Active listening
items.evidence: Agent completed harmless recheck of customer landline at turn 42.

items.name: Took ownership of the problem
items.evidence: Agent proactively placed unbarring order and added International Freedom bolt-on.

items.name: Build rapport and observed professionalism
items.evidence: Agent maintained polite, supportive, and professional tone throughout.

items.name: Probing
items.evidence: Agent gathered necessary details regarding destination and calling requirements.

items.name: Confirmed the issue is resolved
items.evidence: Agent acknowledged issue could not be verified on call due to 2-hour propagation window, leaving customer to test later unassisted.
